# Alico to Present at the 18th Annual Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f33fcc0639376a1c600c038218a02b50/alicoinc/news/2026-11-04_Alico_to_Present_at_the_18th_Annual_Southwest_1465.pdf) November 04, 2026


FORT MYERS, Fla., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alico, Inc. (“Alico” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: ALCO) today announced that John Kiernan, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, will present and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the 18th Annual Southwest IDEAS Conference at The Westin Irving Convention Center Las Colinas in Irving, TX on November 18-19, 2026.


The presentation will begin at 2:00 PM Central Time (3:00 PM Eastern Time) on Wednesday, November 18th. Management will also host one-on-one meetings with investors on Wednesday, November 18th. The presentation will be webcast live and can be accessed through the conference host’s main website:[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/southwest](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wKvsQpC8mV-a3Y6-CuNmAfhGdM7W4pITdEV_acJuqZAiONRpq9EfbqKzRitw5IecMozkJ32FuvxAiWNoLp-bnIADgfmQ_28APv8OXep_TDST0vc3ox97i5LLPbGIaAtS2AcBkYCybcAqLg095B_DM1tiR8qrC5A4_rpI7Pz21iU=) and can be accessed through the “News / Events” tab on the investor relations website at[https://ir.alicoinc.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wKvsQpC8mV-a3Y6-CuNmAUANCS6h1GX0x35eiGMypb7oDjGKd_EyYRGsDP0IoBD6Kl_EBjHLGmUdpFW26SHpMfOCCt9K8SEOLhhmR46_FBCnR3JvsqjV7nDcc_7IGQ5NWQeACgjA2OovfUyUGSyWHBqRPqRhtAKtCMq5BTyvULbseFUsB0u0--FNl8IWzJxewyCH9E6Bto7pqdqRR-pT-eTMkHIPqjf02GrQ5sT7dml5Dj7i0NxuSre99R44SdyL1R4yx7BFiWb5ogdZPwZBfpmfgowVxrezdTNb9NBJ49ZEaNSamI9hIXqWC4ZvAi_iC35sMaXEMSGEvjLn4f7InTsXqvE5h4e2xxrL8_Ntqj-siRSK3yV6bECuBJMezaIzB858dvTFRQ6l23ZxPBvICeOZDAGng5AA1ploZuWPNqiT2CvxB2Cdiyg7XxBuvDKnZgFMqVAkvhU3Qt7cpu-CNdmFvnfwz_IMJR41as4gnA14Klxl3S8EjIsRRDKaIBUY) .


**About Alico**


Alico, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALCO) is a Florida-based agribusiness and land management company with over 125 years of experience. Following its strategic transformation in 2025, Alico operates as a diversified land company with approximately 47,200 acres across 7 Florida counties as of September 30, 2026. The Company focuses on strategic land development opportunities and diversified agricultural operations, leveraging its extensive land portfolio to create long-term shareholder value while maintaining its commitment to responsible land stewardship and conservation. Learn more about Alico at www.alicoinc.com.


**About IDEAS Investor Conferences**


The IDEAS Investor Conferences are held annually and produced by Three Part Advisors, LLC. The mission of the IDEAS Conferences is to provide independent regional venues for quality companies to present their investment merits to an influential audience of investment professionals. Unlike traditional bank-sponsored events, IDEAS Investor Conferences are “SPONSORED BY INVESTORS. FOR INVESTORS.” and for the benefit of regional investment communities. Conference sponsors collectively have more than $200 billion in assets under management and additional information can be found at www.IDEASconferences.com.
